oracle_input.question: These are fictional shipping notes. Draft: nine red crates go to Dock A. Approved revision: three blue crates go to Dock C; this replaces every draft detail. A later comment says the courier likes red, but makes no revision. Report current crates, color, and dock in JSON, then explain which statement is authoritative.

explanation: The approved revision explicitly replaces the draft, so the active shipment contains three blue crates for Dock C. The courier comment is a preference rather than an instruction changing the shipment. It does not restore the superseded color, quantity, or location. The current record follows the stated authority of the revision.
scope: New authored content, fixed before any model outcome.
